facts.fact: The LRA Corporate Strategic Plan 2025-2029 says ASYCUDA has played a pivotal role in augmenting customs operations and tables its status as extended to Freeport of Liberia, RIA and Buchanan.
The plan tables an ASYCUDA extension project with expected result of extension to five rural ports.
The plan tables LITAS with an expected result of all modules functional and rolled out to all Tax Business Offices.
The plan says LITAS registration, return processing and payment modules are operational and rolled out to one Tax Business Office, and lists e-filing among the LRA's strengths.
The plan says a growing number of taxpayers use direct transfer and mobile money to pay taxes, and lists e-payments among the LRA's strengths.
